name: Clear DirectX Shader Cache
description: Removes temporary DirectX shader cache files that Windows and games can rebuild when needed. This helps fix graphics glitches or stutters after driver updates, but may cause longer loading times on the first launch.

description_i18n.en: Removes temporary DirectX shader cache files that Windows and games can rebuild when needed. This helps fix graphics glitches or stutters after driver updates, but may cause longer loading times on the first launch.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt temporäre DirectX-Shader-Cache-Dateien, die Windows und Spiele bei Bedarf neu erstellen können. Dies hilft bei Grafikfehlern nach Treiberupdates, kann aber beim ersten Start zu längeren Ladezeiten führen.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime les fichiers temporaires du cache de shaders DirectX que Windows et les jeux peuvent reconstruire si nécessaire. Cela aide à corriger des graphismes défectueux après une mise à jour pilote, mais peut allonger le temps de chargement au premier lancement.

warnings.title: Temporary Performance Impact on First Launch
warnings.message: Games and applications will rebuild shader cache after cleanup, which can temporarily cause longer loading times or short stutters during the first launch. This action does not directly increase FPS

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Deletes existing temporary data from the user's LOCALAPPDATA directory at D3DSCache without disabling future caching
